symptom: 自维护循环结构化QA门禁误拒平台等效测试命令，即使QA报告明确标注目标分支pytest通过，仍因命令格式包含括号注释或硬编码测试文件名匹配失败而返回structured_qa_focused_command_not_passed。
root_cause: _matches_focused_test_command 函数将目标测试文件名硬编码为test_self_maintenance_loop_runner_policy.py，不支持从动态传入的focused_command提取目标；同时无法解析QA在命令后附加的(parenthetical notes)（如"(target branch)"、"(27 tests passed)"），导致shlex解析失败或路径匹配失败。
fix_diff: 1. 从传入的focused_command动态提取所有.py后缀文件的文件名作为匹配目标，移除硬编码测试文件名；2. 增加括号注释剥离逻辑，在解析命令前移除所有(...)格式的备注内容；3. 增加shlex解析失败的fallback逻辑，移除引号后重试解析；4. 增加python_index边界检查防止索引越界。

executable_template.applicability_check: Apply when structured QA reports include platform-equivalent pytest commands that pass but are rejected, especially when commands contain parenthetical notes or test files other than the hardcoded self-maintenance policy test.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Update _matches_focused_test_command to dynamically extract target test filenames from the focused command, strip parenthetical QA notes before parsing, add quote-fallback parsing, and add index bounds checks.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the _matches_focused_test_command function to its prior hardcoded implementation if this causes valid failed commands to be incorrectly accepted.
